name: agent-skill-package-manifest
explain: Structure and validate production agent skill packages. Enforces explicit manifest declarations, separates procedural guidance from tool capability primitives, and validates tool dependencies before activation.
steps: Declare host capabilities and package a domain skill with negative boundaries and required tools. || Validate manifest dependencies, ensuring unsupported tool requirements fail registration safely.
expect: Agent skill package manifest verified: skill_registered='citation_audit', tools_bound=['highlight_citation', 'read_source_excerpt'], dependency_check_passed=True

name: progressive-skill-disclosure
explain: Implement multi-tier progressive disclosure for agent skills: Tier 1 discovery metadata in prompt, Tier 2 on-demand SKILL.md procedural workflow, and Tier 3 lazy loading of referenced schemas.
steps: Render lightweight discovery catalog in system prompt without loading full procedure bodies. || Match user intent, load procedural instructions dynamically, and fetch supporting schemas on demand.
expect: Progressive skill disclosure verified: catalog_skills=2, tier1_discovery_rendered=True, tier2_loaded='skill_citation_audit', tier3_lazy_loaded='rubric.json'

name: instruction-precedence-evaluator
explain: Enforce the instruction precedence hierarchy: Host System Policy > User Constraints > Skill Instructions > Retrieved Content. Prevents procedural skill instructions from widening permissions or bypassing tenant isolation.
steps: Evaluate legitimate skill operations against host security ceilings and user session constraints. || Intercept unauthorized tool requests and cross-tenant operations initiated by skills, blocking them deterministically.
expect: Instruction precedence evaluator verified: valid_op_approved=True, unauthorized_tool_blocked=True, tenant_breach_blocked=True, violations_recorded=2

name: portable-skill-contract-validator
explain: Validate portable skill input/output contracts and version compatibility. Enforces semantic versioning rules, checks host runtime tool dependencies, and validates runtime invocation payloads.
steps: Verify skill contract integrity, semantic versioning format, and required host tool dependencies. || Validate invocation payloads against required input parameters, rejecting malformed calls.
expect: Portable skill contract validator verified: semver=1.3.0, host_compatible=True, input_validation_passed=True

name: skill-authority-boundary
explain: Enforce the competence vs authority boundary for agent skills. Intercepts tool calls initiated by skills, evaluates caller authentication and RBAC roles, and rejects self-authorizing prompt claims.
steps: Process authorized tool requests matching the caller's role and tenant boundary. || Intercept adversarial skill tool requests attempting cross-tenant access, sensitive table reads, or unauthorized admin actions.
expect: Skill authority boundary verified: legitimate_approved=True, cross_tenant_blocked=True, sensitive_resource_blocked=True, self_authorization_denied=True, blocked_attempts=3
